description: Lists everything buyable here over the x402 pay-as-you-fetch protocol, with each resource_id, its price and the inputs it takes: a trust passport for any Base wallet (see trust_check_wallet), the same in bulk for up to 50 counterparties, workforce directory search, on-chain settlement verification and prompt-injection screening. Needs no account, and neither does paying. Call this before data_buy.
name: data_list_for_sale
